title: Longest Word by Reference
hints: After `longest_word` returns, the string your reference points to must still exist. Which strings survive the call: the ones inside `words`, or a local variable declared in the function body?
Do not copy anything. Keep `std::size_t best = 0;` as an *index* into `words`, update it in the loop when you find a strictly longer word, and `return words[best];` at the end.
